info.title: Casitrace API
info.description: Food traceability and evidence API, served under /api. Business routes are versioned under /api/v1. Authentication endpoints (Better Auth) live under /api/v1/auth. Each operation's `x-access` states who may call it.

Boundary.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, WGS 84 [longitude, latitude]

ImportRequest.description: UTF-8 CSV text with a header row; max 2 MB and 5,000 rows.

VoidEvent.description: Voids an event; optionally records its corrected replacement in the same transaction.

GrantInput.description: granteeOrgId null = every organisation downstream of the lot

canonical.description: The exact signed bytes (UTF-8 canonical JSON)

StartRecall.description: mode=drill runs the same flow without flagging lots or notifying anyone outside the organisation
